Name: POSTURE_CONTROL_PARAM_WEP_LEFT_ST
Description: Weapon posture twist for the left-hand weapon while not two-handing (every value counts as 0 while two-handing; PostureControlParam_WepRight then drives the left arm). Row ID = posture type × 100 + the left weapon's Posture Control ID (Left); posture type is 0 normally, 1 while riding Torrent and 2 while in stealth (crouching). Each aNNN group is picked by the right-hand weapon's one-handed motion category (0, 2 or 3; other categories get no twist), and a missing row gives 0. Values are the maximum twist: the behaviour script scales them by a weight set by the current animation's TimeAct events and eases toward the result (up to 90 per second). Retail rows use the same values in all three groups.

Fields.Name: [a000] Left Arm - Front/Back
Fields.Description: Left arm forward/back twist. Combined with the chest armour's value (PostureControlParam_Pro): the one with the larger magnitude is used. Used when the right-hand weapon's one-handed motion category is 0. Twist amount; retail uses whole numbers. 0 is no twist.
